authorization: User authorized additional worthwhile, time-limited comparisons and at most a beneficial production rerun. This amendment fixes the added scope before seeing production test results.
selection: Same four-dataset qualified development panel and original promotion gates; insufficient exposure is inconclusive and retains the existing production recipe.
data_policy: Fresh pretrained-base LoRA pilots, train split only, original relative weights renormalized across retained datasets. No new data, microphone, quality, rank, method, seed or learning-rate search.
comparison_limits: Two omission comparisons are a bounded screen, not a causal ranking or proof of an optimal mixture. Exposure and training duration can differ at the declared caps. Existing bootstrap intervals are not corrected for the entire model search.
production_policy: Finish and preserve production_all_audio. Defer its frozen scoring until the extension recipe is selected. Refit from the base on retained qualified train plus dev for three passes only if an omission qualifies; otherwise retain production_all_audio. No decisions from either production test. No further trials.
rationale: Standalone CHiME-6 adaptation showed cross-domain regressions; VOiCES showed limited macro benefit despite domain gains. Those results cannot determine their marginal benefit inside the mixture. Compare these two omissions against a longer matched mixed reference; retain clearly useful age and AMI coverage.
